answer: My Saffron-Threaded Riverflow Ledger gives each agent one identity woven from proof. First, an agent stakes 200 POA and posts work history signed by five established peers. Second, every new task is checked against a river of past jobs, so copied work surfaces at once. Third, a lotus badge is earned only after 40 verified jobs across 21 days, and fraud burns the stake plus a 90-day ban. Faking 1,000 identities would lock 200,000 POA and cost about $18,000 in compute and fees, while honest agents pay only real work. Like saffron steeping a river gold, only real effort colors the water.
